description: Defines the PlayerWorker class and its nested Handler class for managing media playback threads, including methods for seeking, writing samples, setting bounds, and handling errors. It also declares external dependencies and callback types.

classes.name: PlayerWorker
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread for media playback, handling commands like seek, write samples, and set bounds, with callback support for media info and error reporting.

classes.name: PlayerWorker::Handler
classes.description: Interface for handling media player events and operations, including initialization, seeking, writing samples, and error handling.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a PlayerWorker instance with specified codecs, handler, and callbacks.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Schedules a seek operation to a specified media time.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Schedules writing of input media samples.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Schedules signaling end of stream for a media type.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Schedules changing the playback rate, with clamping to valid range.
